title: Bulk Stock CSV Import: Upload & Automatic Header Mapping

intro.title: Bulk Stock CSV Import
intro.subtitle: Legacy software migration, CSV file upload, and intelligent fuzzy header mapping

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4, Part 5: Bulk Stock CSV Import and Automatic Header Mapping. Migrating thousands of medicines from legacy software is seamless with MediFlow's smart import engine.
From Inventory, click Import to open the Smart Import portal, designed to ingest spreadsheets from distributors and third-party pharmacy tools.
You can prepare your spreadsheet using standard columns: medicine name, batch number, expiry date, quantity, MRP, and purchase rate.
Drag and drop your CSV file into the upload zone. MediFlow reads the file instantaneously on your browser without server upload delays.
The fuzzy matching engine automatically maps diverse vendor column headers to standard ERP fields. In Part 6, explore Validation and AI Enrichment.

outro.takeaway: Bulk CSV Import: Upload legacy inventory spreadsheets with automatic fuzzy header mapping to ingest thousands of medicines in seconds.
